name: MixMod dynamic-mask multi-model guider
plain: Each active model makes its own cond/uncond pair. Each model's mask starts at its normalized weight and, up to step 15, decays toward a map of where that model's |c − u| (channel mean, first batch item only) is the largest of all models and above threshold times the global maximum. The masks are normalized to sum to 1, optionally Gaussian blurred and renormalized, and each model's own CFG output is blended by its mask. It also writes debug/mask_i.png to the working directory on every step after the first.
math:
aᵢ = mean_ch |cᵢ − uᵢ| (batch item 0); domᵢ = [argmax_j a_j = i]·[aᵢ > τ·max a].
mᵢ ← δ·mᵢ + (1 − δ)·domᵢ while step ≤ 15 (mᵢ starts at weightᵢ); m̂ᵢ = blur_σ(mᵢ/Σ_j m_j), renormalized to sum 1.
x̂ = Σᵢ m̂ᵢ·(uᵢ + sᵢ(cᵢ − uᵢ)).

props.params: decay_factor=0.9, threshold=0.1, blur_sigma=0.5; per-model cfg and weight from the component chain
